meta.search_prefix: Only the first {n} characters are searchable
meta.truncated: Too long — only the beginning was saved
meta.rendered_prefix: Showing the first {n} characters; pasting uses the full text

empty.title: Copy something and it will show up here
empty.detail: Text, images and files you copy with {key} are kept automatically
empty.filtered_detail: Press {key} to switch to another type

no_result.title: Nothing matches “{query}”
no_result.detail: Try another word — even one or two characters work
no_result.detail_short: Searches shorter than {min} characters only cover the latest {limit} items — type {min} or more to search all history

recording.disabled: Clipboard recording is off; new copies aren’t saved

history_too_new: The history was written by a newer Wisp and can’t be read by this version; new copies aren’t recorded
history_unavailable: Clipboard history can’t be read right now; new copies aren’t recorded
watch_unavailable: The clipboard can’t be recorded in this desktop session; new copies aren’t saved

confirm.delete_pinned: Press {key} again to delete this pinned item
confirm.clear_synced: Clear clipboard history? Items on your other devices will be cleared too.

status.secret_skipped: Skipped something that looked like a password or key
status.files_gone: These files no longer exist — they may have been moved or deleted
status.image_gone: The image file no longer exists
status.webview_unsupported: Files can’t be copied from clipboard history in this session

failed.clear: Couldn’t clear history — nothing was removed
failed.pause: Couldn’t pause recording — please try again
failed.resume: Couldn’t resume recording — please try again
failed.save_image: The image wasn’t saved — please try again
failed.translate: Couldn’t start translating — please try again

reason.wayland: Wayland doesn’t let Wisp press the paste key for you
reason.elevated: The target app runs as administrator, so Wisp can’t paste into it
reason.focus_timeout: Couldn’t switch back to the original app in time
reason.no_permission: Wisp lacks the permission needed to paste for you
reason.no_permission_macos: Wisp needs Accessibility permission to paste for you

action.allow_accessibility: Allow Wisp in Privacy & Security › Accessibility
